Title: Gas Tungsten Arc Welding(1)
Description: An essential training session for ITI Welder students covering the core concepts, equipment setup, and techniques for Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (GTAW) and Thermit welding processes.

Title: GTAW Current Types(2)
Description: An essential technical guide for ITI Welder students explaining GTAW (TIG) current types—DCEN, DCEP, and AC—and their specific effects on penetration, cleaning action, and electrode life.

Title: GTAW ACDC Power(3)
Description: An essential technical session for ITI Welder students explaining the principles of AC/DC power sources in Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (GTAW/TIG), focusing on current selection and polarity effects.

Title: Tungsten Electrodes(4)
Description: An essential technical guide for ITI Welder students explaining the different types of tungsten electrodes, color-coding standards, and their specific applications in TIG welding.

Title: GTAW Torches(5)
Description: An essential technical guide for ITI Welder students explaining GTAW (TIG) torch components, collet and nozzle selections, and proper handling for precise arc control.

Title: GTAW Filler Rods(6)
Description: A specialized training video for ITI Welder students explaining how to select and use GTAW (TIG) filler rods based on material composition, thickness, and welding specifications.

Title: Gas Tungsten Arc Welding(7)
Description: An essential training guide for Welder trade students covering the core principles, equipment setup, and precise techniques of Gas Tungsten Arc Welding (GTAW/TIG).

Title: Friction and Laser Beam Welding(8)
Description: An advanced training video for Welder trade students explaining the principles, equipment setups, and operational techniques for both Friction Welding and Laser Beam Welding.
